[[File:Golden_Globe_Awards_signs.jpg | thumb|right | alt=Signs for the Golden Globe Awards | Signs for the Golden Globe Awards]]
The '''12th [[Golden Globe Award]]s''', honoring the best in [[film]] for [[1954 in film|1954]], were held on February 24, 1955, in the Cocoanut Grove at the Ambassador Hotel in [[Los Angeles]], [[California]].<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.ropeofsilicon.com/award_show/golden_globe_awards/1955/ |title="The 1955 Golden Globe Award Winners |access-date=2011-12-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20080308235733/http://www.ropeofsilicon.com/award_show/golden_globe_awards/1955 |archive-date=2008-03-08 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

==Winners ==

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Motion Picture – Drama|Best Motion Picture - Drama]]===
''' ''[[On the Waterfront]]'' directed by [[Elia Kazan]]'''<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1954 |title="Best Motion Picture Drama" 1954 |access-date=2011-12-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120415111807/http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1954 |archive-date=2012-04-15 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Motion Picture – Musical or Comedy|Best Motion Picture - Comedy or Musical]]===
''' ''[[Carmen Jones (film)|Carmen Jones]]'' directed by [[Otto Preminger]]'''<ref name="auto1">{{Cite web|url=https://www.imdb.com/event/ev0000292/1955/1|title=Golden Globes, USA (1955)|website=IMDb}}</ref>

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Actor – Motion Picture Drama|Best Performance by an Actor in a Motion Picture - Drama]]===
''' [[Marlon Brando]] - ''[[On the Waterfront]]'''''<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1954 |title="Best Motion Picture Actor/Drama" 1954 |access-date=2011-12-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120415111807/http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1954 |archive-date=2012-04-15 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Actress in a Motion Picture – Drama|Best Performance by an Actress in a Motion Picture - Drama]]===
''' [[Grace Kelly]] - ''[[The Country Girl (1954 film)|The Country Girl]]'''''<ref>{{Cite web |url=http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1954 |title="Best Motion Picture Actress/Drama" 1954 |access-date=2011-12-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120415111807/http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1954 |archive-date=2012-04-15 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Actor – Motion Picture Musical or Comedy|Best Performance by an Actor in a Motion Picture - Comedy or Musical]]===
''' [[James Mason]] - ''[[A Star Is Born (1954 film)|A Star Is Born]]'''''<ref name="auto">{{Cite web |url=http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1954 |title="Best Motion Picture Actor/Musical or Comedy" 1954 |access-date=2011-12-17 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20120415111807/http://www.goldenglobes.org/browse/year/1954 |archive-date=2012-04-15 |url-status=dead }}</ref>

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Actress – Motion Picture Comedy or Musical|Best Performance by an Actress in a Motion Picture - Comedy or Musical]]===
''' [[Judy Garland]] - ''[[A Star Is Born (1954 film)|A Star Is Born]]'''''<ref name="auto"/>

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Supporting Actor – Motion Picture|Best Performance by an Actor in a Supporting Role in a Motion Picture]]===

===[[Golden Globe Award for Best Director|Best Director - Motion Picture]]===
